mainEntity.name: What type of treatment does iRecover Alberta offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: iRecover Alberta specializes in the treatment of substance abuse disorders and offers a range of evidence-based therapies and services to meet the unique needs of each participant. Their treatment programs include medically supervised detoxification, psychiatric assessment and treatment, one-on-one counseling, group counseling, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), fitness and nutrition programs, family support, private single rooms, and group outings and recreational activities.

mainEntity.name: Is a doctor referral needed to access iRecover Alberta's services?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, there is no wait list or doctor referral needed to access iRecover Alberta’s services. The only requirement for admission is the desire to change one’s life.

mainEntity.name: How long are the treatment programs at iRecover Alberta?

acceptedAnswer.text: iRecover Alberta offers 4, 8, and 12-week treatment programs to meet the unique needs and challenges of each participant.

mainEntity.name: Are the treatment programs at iRecover Alberta individualized?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, iRecover Alberta’s treatment programs are designed to address the unique needs and challenges of each participant, providing them with individualized care and support.

mainEntity.name: What type of aftercare does iRecover Alberta offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: iRecover Alberta’s Lifetime Aftercare Program and membership in the iRecover Alumni Group provide ongoing support and accountability for participants after they complete their treatment.

mainEntity.name: Are the rehab centers at iRecover Alberta co-ed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the rehab centers at iRecover Alberta are co-ed.

about_blocks.text: iRecover Alberta is a drug and addiction treatment center that offers specialized treatment programs for individuals suffering from substance abuse disorders. With a focus on lifelong recovery, iRecover’s rapid access facilities ensure that individuals can begin their treatment journey immediately, without having to wait for a doctor referral. The center offers medically supervised detoxification and around-the-clock medical staff to ensure the safety and comfort of participants throughout their treatment.
about_blocks.html: iRecover Alberta is a drug and addiction treatment center that offers specialized treatment programs for individuals suffering from substance abuse disorders. With a focus on lifelong recovery, iRecover’s rapid access facilities ensure that individuals can begin their treatment journey immediately, without having to wait for a doctor referral. The center offers medically supervised detoxification and around-the-clock medical staff to ensure the safety and comfort of participants throughout their treatment.

about_blocks.text: The addiction treatment program at iRecover Alberta is world-class, offering a range of services to meet the unique needs of each participant. The program includes 4, 8, and 12-week treatment programs, one-on-one counseling, and group counseling. Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is also available during weeks 5-8 of the program. Participants have access to psychiatric assessment and treatment from Dr. Avi Aulakh, a renowned addictions expert.
about_blocks.html: The addiction treatment program at iRecover Alberta is world-class, offering a range of services to meet the unique needs of each participant. The program includes 4, 8, and 12-week treatment programs, one-on-one counseling, and group counseling. Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is also available during weeks 5-8 of the program. Participants have access to psychiatric assessment and treatment from Dr. Avi Aulakh, a renowned addictions expert.

about_blocks.text: iRecover Alberta’s treatment program also includes fitness and nutrition programs, family support during visiting days, private single rooms with en-suite bathrooms, and group outings and recreational activities. The center provides transportation to and from outside meetings, and participants are given a computer tablet pre-loaded with the full program content, enabling them with ongoing access to the four live 12-step meetings per day following their treatment. The center’s Lifetime Aftercare Program and membership in the iRecover Alumni Group provide ongoing support and accountability for participants after they complete their treatment.
